data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement is purely an artifact of a tool error (API failure for .SRCINFO in the qwen model), not a genuine security disagreement. The deepseek model successfully reviewed all files and found no issues.
coverage_issues: qwen model failed to review .SRCINFO due to an HTTP 400 API error, resulting in an overall inconclusive package verdict.
learnings: Transient API errors on low-risk metadata files like .SRCINFO should not force an overall 'inconclusive' package verdict if the primary executable files (PKGBUILD) are verified safe.
